features: 500GB STORAGE: Portable 500GB external hard drive for storing documents, photos, videos, music, backups and other everyday files.
USB 3.0 WITH UASP: USB 3.0 interface supports data transfer speeds up to 5Gbps with UASP support for improved transfer performance.
COMPACT 2.5-INCH DESIGN: Slim and portable design makes it convenient to carry and suitable for compatible laptops, desktops and gaming consoles.
PLUG & PLAY: Tool-free setup with plug-and-play functionality for convenient use with supported Windows, macOS and Linux systems.
LED & SHOCK PROTECTION: LED activity indicator provides drive status visibility, while the cushioned internal layer helps protect the installed hard drive from physical impact.

320GB Portable Storage: This 2.5-inch external hard drive provides 320GB of ample storage—perfect for backing up important documents, high-resolution media, software libraries, or game data in a compact and travel-ready design.

Tool-Free, Plug & Play Compatibility: No tools or drivers required—just plug it in and go. Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, and works effortlessly with desktops, laptops, tablets, mobile phones, and gaming consoles.

Shockproof Design with Activity LED Indicator: Built-in shock-absorbing sponge layer protects the drive from impact damage, while the LED indicator flashes to show read/write activity, giving you both durability and operational feedback.
description: GEONIX PowerShell S3 320GB External Hard Drive, engineered for high-speed performance, wide compatibility, and long-term durability. Compact yet powerful, this 2.5-inch portable drive is equipped with a USB 3.0 interface and supports UASP protocol, offering blazing transfer speeds up to 5Gbps, perfect for fast backups, media transfers, and real-time editing. With 320gb of storage capacity, it’s ideal for professionals, students, gamers, and travelers who need a reliable space to store files, media, and applications. Tool-free and plug-and-play, setup is effortless—no drivers or installation needed. Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, this drive also supports smartphones, tablets, and gaming consoles for maximum flexibility. A shockproof internal sponge layer helps protect the hard disk against accidental bumps or drops, while the LED indicator provides clear visual feedback during read/write operations.—complete with a 3-year warranty for worry-free performance.
